liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Sugaree** (2 reviews): Sugaree and the post-Samson section are highlighted as main show moments; Second set Sugaree placement is unusual, though the set locks in later [18][24]
- **Mississippi Half-Step Uptown Toodeloo** (1 review): Opener is a favorite version, featuring a roaring Tiger and deep Phil [20]

## The recordings

- **gd1979-07-01.mtx.seamons.95742.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 194 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [1]. Said about its sound: High energy performance maintains a consistent groove without slowing down; Matrix tape sounds lovely and warm, with nothing lacking in quality [16][21]
- **gd1979-07-01.141413.akg.d224e.holhwein.lee.smith.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 23 songs; 175 min [3]
- **gd1979-07-01.fob.nak700.menke.motb-0112.105210.flac16**: audience recording; 21 songs; 188 min; rated 4.75/5 by 4 [5]. Said about its sound: Garcia solos are focused; audience comment praises the sound system; Passenger version is compelling; Jerry and Bob interplay is in lockstep [22][26]
- **gd1979-07-01.145358.fob.sony.ecm270.severson.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 21 songs; 196 min [6]
- **gd1979-07-01.sbd.miller.93433.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 21 songs; 171 min; rated 4/5 by 6 [8]. Said about its sound: Bass is heavy on Phil and drums, but subwoofers help [19]
- **gd1979-07-01.156180.5-1.tobin.flac1648**: source not stated; 21 songs; 169 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [13]. Said about its sound: Clear sound despite venue echo; Sugaree opening minutes have amazing clarity [27]

## Around the show

- Recording is missing Mexicali Blues and has duplicate Passenger tracks [23]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1979-07-01.mtx.seamons.95742.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Hunter Seamons; source: Matrix mix (SBD/AUD) [1]. Also: Recorded by Mark Severson on Sony ECM-270s; transferred by David Minches [1]
- **gd1979-07-01.141413.akg.d224e.holhwein.lee.smith.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Reinhart Holhwein; transferred by Pat Lee and Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller and Matt Smith; source: Reinhart Holhwein's Master Audience Cassettes; AKG D224E mics > Sony TC-158 > Pat Lee's 1st generation Reels [3]
- **gd1979-07-01.fob.nak700.menke.motb-0112.105210.flac16**: taped by Bob Menke; transferred by Bob Menke and Derek McCabe; source: 2 x Nak CM 700's >> Sony TC-D5 >> MAC ; Analog Audience Source: FOB Master Cassettes (MAC) Medium Stock Brands: MAC = 2 x Maxell UDXL-II Analog [5]
- **gd1979-07-01.145358.fob.sony.ecm270.severson.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Mark Severson; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Mark Severson's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; Sony ECM-270 mics (mounted on pole, slightly left of center, 35' from stage)> Sony TC-158SD (Maxell UDXLII) [6]
- **gd1979-07-01.sbd.miller.93433.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master [8]. Also: FOB Sony ECM-270 cassette master supplies specific track segments [8]
- **gd1979-07-01.156180.5-1.tobin.flac1648**: transferred by 5.1 LPCM Surround Sound Mix (48k) by Kevin Tobin; source: 5.1 LPCM Surround Sound Mix (48k) [13]
